metadata.source_scope: Allowed sources from Blocker Burndown 01 prompt

DT_BINDING.evidence: Downstream uses `qcom,wcd9378-codec` (wcd9378.c:4591-4593); upstream binding only has 9370/9375 (qcom,wcd937x.yaml:21-27).
DT_BINDING.notes: Fallback compatibility chain remains FAIL_CLOSED pending evidence.

DT_BINDING.patch_scope: Decide if `qcom,swr-tx-port-params` needs binding addition or should be removed by conversion mapping.
DT_BINDING.evidence: Consumed downstream (wcd9378.c:4726-4730) but absent upstream schema (qcom,wcd937x-sdw.yaml:17-100).
DT_BINDING.notes: FAIL_CLOSED until deterministic semantic mapping is proven.

DTS_BOARD.patch_scope: Board DTS migration from legacy properties to upstream schema (`reset-gpios`, `qcom,rx-device`, `qcom,tx-device`, `qcom,*-port-mapping`, `qcom,micbias*-microvolt`).
DTS_BOARD.evidence: Legacy downstream properties in wcd9378.c:4346-4444,4618-4630,4717-4727; upstream property set in qcom,wcd93xx-common.yaml and qcom,wcd937x-sdw.yaml.
DTS_BOARD.notes: Board-specific property value conversion still needs runtime validation.

SOUNDWIRE_CORE.patch_scope: No immediate core patch; only escalate if runtime traces show missing behavior in upstream `bus.c`/`qcom.c`.
SOUNDWIRE_CORE.evidence: Paging and message support already present in bus.c:380-406 and qcom.c transfer/IRQ paths:481-580,716-790,973-1002.

LPASS_MACRO.patch_scope: Do not patch upstream LPASS macros for WCD9378 unless a new generic dependency is proven.
LPASS_MACRO.evidence: No WCD9378 references in upstream lpass-rx-macro.c / lpass-tx-macro.c; downstream coupling is via lpass-cdc event APIs (lpass-cdc/internal.h:43-48, lpass-cdc.c:201-266).
LPASS_MACRO.notes: Treat downstream lpass-cdc event wiring as vendor framework residue unless proven upstream-necessary.

WCD_COMMON_CLSH.patch_scope: Class-H shared module update (if required) for WCD9378 base/version handling.
WCD_COMMON_CLSH.evidence: Shared class-h uses fixed base macros (wcd-clsh-v2.c:91-103) and enum versions up to WCD939X (wcd-clsh-v2.h:44-51).
WCD_COMMON_CLSH.notes: Scope is FAIL_CLOSED until register-address behavior is runtime-verified.

WCD9378_CODEC.patch_scope: Introduce upstream-style WCD9378 main codec driver with upstream DT properties and MBHC/Class-H integration patterns.
WCD9378_CODEC.evidence: Downstream main driver exists (wcd9378.c) with vendor APIs and legacy DT parsing (4346-4444,4675-4699).
WCD9378_CODEC.notes: Must keep unresolved SDW ID and Class-H items FAIL_CLOSED.

WCD9378_SDW.patch_scope: Introduce upstream-style WCD9378 SDW slave driver with confirmed ID and paging support configuration.
WCD9378_SDW.evidence: Downstream SWR slave file uses legacy SWR APIs and string IDs (wcd9378-slave.c:313-321,393-401); downstream enables paging in main codec (wcd9378.c:4509,4518).
WCD9378_SDW.notes: Numeric SDW identity remains FAIL_CLOSED until hardware proof.

DEBUG_ONLY_DO_NOT_UPSTREAM.patch_scope: Exclude debugfs peek/poke/regdump and temporary bring-up print paths from upstream patchset.
DEBUG_ONLY_DO_NOT_UPSTREAM.evidence: Downstream SDW debugfs hooks in wcd9378-slave.c:343-369 and extensive debug paths in legacy stack.

FAIL_CLOSED.patch_scope: Determine verified SDW part ID and OF compatible string for WCD9378 (`0x110` / `sdw20217011000` currently unproven).
FAIL_CLOSED.evidence: No allowed-source proof for proposed values; upstream IDs are 0x10a/0x10d/0x10e in wcd937x/wcd938x/wcd939x SDW drivers.
Downstream requires property (wcd9378.c:4726-4730), upstream binding lacks it (qcom,wcd937x-sdw.yaml).

FAIL_CLOSED.patch_scope: Finalize Class-H base/version strategy for WCD9378.
FAIL_CLOSED.evidence: Address-domain mismatch risk between fixed 0x3000 class-h macros and WCD9378 register base definitions.
